items.content_html: DeckBridge app lets you use a USB Stream Deck (also Mirabox, Ajazz, Fifine, …) with the Elgato Stream Deck app over your local network. It runs on your computer and appears to the app as a network device, so your keys and button images work over network - no Elgato Network Dock required. https://lukasmega.github.io/DeckBridge/
